name: Pressurized Bottle (1-2) OLD
description: One of the potions has decayed, putting it under immense pressure. Its contents have become poisonous. When handled improperly, the bottle bursts, sending glass shards flying everywhere.
disable: DC 17 Thievery (trained) to carefully place the bottle under a bucket or bowl.

generalAbilities.name: Brittle Shatter
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature tries to pick up or move the potion

Effect The bottle shatters into pieces that fill a 5ft Burst. The burst deals 1 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature who takes any damage is exposed to fermented potion.

generalAbilities.name: Fermented Poison
generalAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 1d4 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 2 (1 hour)

Stage 3 2d6 Poison Damage damage and clumsy 2 (1 hour)
